leadText:
Johnny (Japanese: ジオンビ Giambi) is a character of the day who appeared in Shocks and Bonds. He is a Pokémon Trainer who took part in the Double Battle rounds of the Ever Grande Conference.

After defeated Clark in the third of the Trainer's Double Battles, Johnny started his battle against . He sent out his and against Tyson's and .

Ash and Morrison, wanting to see their friend battle, both raced to see Johnny's battle against Tyson. By the time they got there, Johnny's Blastoise and Tyson's Donphan were both defeated, as indicated by the scoreboard. Johnny was down to his Aggron while Tyson had Sceptile.

Johnny had trouble with Sceptile as Sceptile kept on using and its speed to dodge his Aggron's . This caused Aggron to get tired out. Johnny had Aggron use which gave Sceptile a chance to go for . Johnny saw this as an opportunity to finish Sceptile off by having Aggron use Metal Claw but Sceptile's Solar Beam finished charging and unleashed it at Aggron, defeating it. Tyson's victory allowed him to move on to the next round while Johnny was eliminated from the tournament.
